name: Babel TMGMT
description: Babel submodule: a TMGMT source plugin that sends Babel's curated source strings to TMGMT translation providers, including continuous jobs.
project_description: Submodule of Babel (requires drupal/tmgmt). Provides a 'babel' TMGMT source plugin so Babel's curated, active, unlocked source strings can be sent to any TMGMT translator (machine or human/vendor). Supports TMGMT continuous jobs: a cron hook and queue worker create job items for every untranslated, active, unlocked string per continuous job, and event subscribers remove job items when a string is disabled or its translation is locked. TMGMT itself owns the translator connections and credentials; babel_tmgmt only stores the list of enabled translator IDs.
